1. (Currently amended) A method for controlling a flow of air, the method comprising: establishing a level of vacuum in a booster device by generating the flow of air from the booster device using a pump; determining whether the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached a predetermined value; and terminating the flow of air from the booster device when the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached the predetermined value, __wherein said terminating the flow of air includes changing the direction of the flow of air and closing a flow path between the pump and the booster device by opening a flow path between a negative pressure chamber of the pump and a positive pressure chamber of the pump.__

8. (Currently amended) A system for controlling a flow of air, the system comprising: a booster device configured to provide a vacuum assist when a level of vacuum has been established in the device; a pump configured to establish the level of vacuum in the booster device by generating the flow of air from the booster device; and a directional control valve adapted to terminate the flow of air from the booster device when the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached a predetermined value, such that a pressure differential across the pump is reduced, __wherein the directional control valve is further adapted to change the direction of the flow of air and close a flow path between the pump and the booster device by opening a flow path between a negative pressure chamber of the pump and a positive pressure chamber of the pump.__
